description.narrative: In total, curative consultations were provided to 2,678,863 individuals, including 1,161,446 vulnerable children under five years of age. Despite multiple challenges facing South Sudan including an increasingly fragile health system and ongoing insecurity, UNICEF and partners sustained access to basic lifesaving health interventions. | Status:Met | As-of Date:14/12/2018
